caption: This drawing is a monochrome illustration featuring a detailed and realistic depiction of a tankard with a domed lid and a large, curved handle. The main object, the tankard, is shown in a slightly angled side view occupying the center of the composition. The tankard has a smooth cylindrical body with a rolled base and a fitted domed lid that has a thumb lift and a hinge mechanism visible on the left. To the right of the central tankard, there is a detailed drawing of the tankard's hinge, showing the use of rivets and the initials "K H" inscribed above a decorative heart-shaped element. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller technical drawing of the tankard with measurements, showing the height as 6⅞ inches and the width across the base as 5⅞ inches as well as the overall width, including the handle, as 9 inches. In the upper right, the handwritten initials “T.M.A.” are inscribed in a decorative script. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a classic, engraved appearance on an off-white background.
title: Silver Tankard
